entities.summary: David H. Grinspoon is an American astrobiologist. He is the former Senior Scientist for Astrobiology Strategy at NASA (2023-2025) and was the inaugural Baruch S. Blumberg NASA/Library of Congress Chair in Astrobiology for 2012–2013.
